market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $120 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI at ~$103, with recent highs near $109. To hit $120 in May requires roughly 11% above the recent peak. With Hormuz disruption persisting and Iran-US deadlock, a further escalation print of $120 is plausible but well above current levels. Roughly 35-45%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Direction of Hormuz negotiations and any escalation catalysts in May.
